notice: Twelve curated open-weight GGUF candidates with permissive upstream licence families. The collection branding does not claim WASTI NEXUS trained or authored upstream weights. Only entries with pinned immutable revision, exact size, SHA-256 and completed licence/runtime review may be enabled for download. Estimated sizes are approximate and must never be used as download integrity values.
